# Burford's latest research on energy transition disputes featured in Axios


November 14, 2024


-
-
-
-


Axios' legal number of the day is 76%, representing the share of corporate general counsels that encounter disputes around the energy transition, a number from Burford's latest research report, entitled "[Energy transition disputes: GCs and senior lawyers on the business impacts of legal challenges to come](https://www.burfordcapital.com/insights-news-events/insights-research/2024-energy-transition-research/) ."
